method.environment: Headless Chrome; 320/390 x 844 and 1024/1440 x 900 CSS pixels.
method.contrast: Computed CSS colors composited over ancestor backgrounds; active direct text and placeholders. New pseudo-labels inherit the bubble foreground and use the same background. Not a full WCAG audit.
method.layout: Horizontal panel clipping checks exclude maps/SVG; existing zoom-related clipping remains documented separately.
method.readiness: Custom-node state sampled after 350 ms for existing React Flow measurement/rendering; no application timing changed.
method.stateEvidence: Computed pseudo-content, existing selection data/classes, local feedback rectangles, contextual topic text and existing animation names.
method.randomness: Questions and simulation choices are random in the existing demo; screenshots are not a controlled content-matched A/B experiment.
